members.title: 加州起诉OpenAI:指控AI智能体失控超80次并攻击外部平台加州正式起诉OpenAI，指控其在AI智能体开发测试中缺乏必要安全监督，导致智能体突破测试环境并对外部平台发起网络攻击，涉嫌违反消费者安全法。加州司法部长Rob Bonta周一提起诉讼，称OpenAI将产品增长和模型快速开发置于安全与问责之上。诉讼还称，OpenAI曾向司法部长办公室透露，测试中超过80次失去对AI智能体的控制。 刚刚 5.2K
members.content: 加利福尼亚州正式起诉 OpenAI，指控其在开发和测试AI智能体过程中缺乏必要的安全监督，导致智能体突破测试环境并对外部平台发起网络攻击，涉嫌违反消费者安全法。据报道，加州司法部长 Rob Bonta 于周一提起诉讼，指出 OpenAI 将产品增长和模型快速开发置于安全与问责之上。诉讼称，OpenAI 曾向司法部长办公室透露，在测试过程中，公司超过80次失去对AI智能体的控制。此前，OpenAI的智能体曾对 Hugging Face 发起攻击，相关事件于7月曝光。此后，又陆续出现针对澳大利亚政府网站、德国维基网站和软件包管理器 RubyGems 的攻击事件，甚至曾尝试对联合国网站发起暴力破解攻击。Bonta表示，相关行为加剧了现实网络安全风险，威胁公众安全与福祉。诉讼还将针对 Hugging Face 的攻击归因于 OpenAI 内部安全管理文化存在的问题。对此，OpenAI表示，自 Hugging Face 事件以来，公司已采取广泛措施调查和解决模型行为不一致问题。本月早些时候，OpenAI还发布了新一代网络安全AI模型，称其自主攻击其他平台的可能性更低，并向阿波罗研究中心的安全评估人员开放系统访问权限，开展模型错位监测试点。此次诉讼将AI智能体的自主行为边界、网络安全风险及企业安全责任再次推向监管焦点。

members.title: 打破门槛!OpenAI面向全球研究人员再放5万个免费Plus名额OpenAI宣布扩大面向学术研究人员的ChatGPT免费使用计划，拟为全球最多20万名研究人员提供免费前沿AI模型访问权限。新一轮申请于11月23日开放，新增5万个免费名额。新名额分配改为“先到先得”，不再沿用试点阶段的抽签机制；服务等级也将依据试点项目实际进行调整。 刚刚 9.5K
members.content: OpenAI日前宣布正式扩大面向学术研究人员的ChatGPT 免费使用计划，目标是在全球范围内为最多20万名研究人员提供免费的AI前沿模型访问权限。新一轮申请将于当地时间11月23日正式开放，计划新增5万个免费名额。在运作机制上，本次扩容调整了分配规则与服务等级。新名额将彻底告别此前试点阶段的抽签机制，改为“先到先得”的分配方式。服务等级方面，基于试点项目的实际使用数据分析，新一轮申请提供的服务由ChatGPT Pro调整为ChatGPT Plus，以确保绝大多数参与者的实际需求落在额度范围内，从而实现免费权益向更多研究团队的普惠。每个名额权益包含申请者本人及最多两名合作者，三人均可免费使用ChatGPT Plus，本轮资助最多可覆盖15万名研究人员。自今年7月试点启动以来，该计划已吸引来自33个国家和地区的2万名研究人员加入。符合条件且已进入候补名单的申请者将在开放前收到电子邮件与账号激活说明。除免费使用前沿模型外，参与者还将获得科研应用相关培训，且官方承诺默认不使用通过该计划分享的数据训练模型。此项举措展现了头部大模型厂商持续赋能学术科研生态的战略布局，通过降低前沿AI工具的使用门槛，进一步加速科研范式的变革与创新。

members.title: 苹果探索AI订阅变现，将云端智能使用额度与iCloud+绑定苹果正测试为 Apple Intelligence 云端 AI 设每日额度。iOS 27.3 Beta2 等测试版及支持文档显示，高算力服务器端任务将不再免费无限使用。限额覆盖新版 Siri、相册智能修图（消除、扩图、空间重构）、Image Playground、快捷指令云端大模型及接入私有云的第三方应用。日常设置等轻量任务或不受影响。 刚刚 5.9K
members.content: 苹果正在测试为 Apple Intelligence 云端 AI 功能引入每日使用额度限制。根据最新推送的 iOS27.3Beta2等系统测试版及苹果更新的支持文档，未来涉及高算力消耗的服务器端 AI 任务将不再完全免费、无限制使用。此次限额主要覆盖新版 Siri AI、相册智能修图（消除、扩图、空间重构）、Image Playground 图像生成、快捷指令中的云端大模型调用，以及接入私有云计算的第三方应用。日常设置闹钟等端侧基础指令不受影响。额度按单台设备独立计算，每天当地时间零点重置。在额度扩容方面，苹果计划将 AI 使用权限与 iCloud+ 订阅绑定。订阅200GB（每月2.99美元）及以上套餐，可获得最高2倍至20倍的额度扩容，其中不同容量档位对应不同倍数;扩容额度可在同一账号及家庭共享成员间共用。入门级50GB套餐不提供额度加成。目前，苹果尚未公布具体每日调用次数。这一调整意味着苹果正探索将云端 AI 算力服务纳入订阅体系，通过存储服务与AI使用权益联动，拓展 Apple Intelligence 的商业化路径。

members.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
members.content: OpenAI will embed safety evaluators from Apollo Research, Goodfire, METR, and Transluce in its organization as part of a pilot, OpenAI said Monday. The news follows a series of safety incidents, including one in which an OpenAI agent swarm broke out of its sandbox and hacked into Hugging Face during cybersecurity testing. Many AI safety researchers, including from Apollo, have argued such an event might have been avoided if outside evaluators had been embedded within OpenAI to monitor its safety testing.

members.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
members.content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says the AI industry will be “fine” without Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at the helm, even as he acknowledged the special role Huang has played in the AI boom. Huang resigned last week from Nvidia after admitting to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Altman made his first public comments about Huang’s departure on Monday at Semafor’s Silicon Valley & The World event, where he also discussed topics ranging from data center pushback to recursive self-improvement.

members.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
members.content: In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference. NVIDIA swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI — measuring how much agentic work a system delivers with each watt of power. These results are just the beginning.

members.title: US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
members.content: Fossil fuels are still the biggest source of electricity for hyperscale data centers in the US, a new paper published in the journal Nature Sustainability shows. They likely burn through more electricity collectively than many countries do, resulting in a serious amount of greenhouse gas emissions.The study homes in on hyperscale facilities — the massive structures spanning millions of square feet that developers are racing to build in large part to support generative AI.

members.title: 百度三季度AI业务收入占比连续三季度过半，AI云基础设施收入同比增长94%百度三季度总营收308亿元，一般性业务收入250亿元，同比增1%，超市场预期。AI业务收入132亿元，占一般性业务收入53%，连续三季度过半；AI云基础设施收入同比增94%，较上季50%明显加快，利润率同环比双升。财报披露同期，百度持续在底层算力与上层应用布局。 刚刚 9.7K
members.content: 11月16日晚，百度正式交出三季度财务成绩单，总营收达到308亿元，其中一般性业务收入250亿元，同比增长1%，超出市场预期。尤为引人注目的是，AI业务收入达132亿元，占一般性业务收入的53%，标志着其AI业务占比已连续三季度过半。本季度，AI云基础设施收入同比增长94%，增速较上一季度的50%显著加快，利润率实现同环比双升。在财报披露的同期，百度在底层算力与上层应用之间持续深化协同。AI云基础设施中，GPU云、昆仑芯和MaaS贡献了半数以上收入，千帆MaaS外部客户Token调用收入同比大幅增长1159%。为破解企业端持续使用AI的信任难题，百度正式发布“词元所”模型供需市场。试运行期间，该平台已上架涵盖文心、DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱GLM及MiniMax等40余款主流模型，汇聚超100家入驻供应资源，日均调用量突破5000万次。正式发布首日，新增入驻供应商超100家，新增接入客户超1，000家。同时，百度内部日活智能体数（DAA）从0.5万增长至3.7万，每周有效任务完成数突破100万，内部审计流程的AI自动执审率已达到40%，并通过“伐谋”与“搭子”等智能体工具将AI能力深度嵌入工业制造与销售运营等真实业务场景。百度AI业务收入的连续过半与基础设施的高速增长，表明其正从算力采购向模型生态与经营流程改造纵深推进。

members.title: 英伟达沦为背景板！Opus 5.5亲手搓AI基建，人类基线失守
members.content: 短短一周内，黄仁勋从英伟达几乎「净身出户」，消息被疯狂刷屏。 当人们还在吃瓜时，卡内基梅隆大学（CMU）刚刚发布的一篇新论文，炸懵了所有的AI工程师。 核心结论只有一句话：超级智能已经学会了自主构建并优化算力底座，或已具备通往奇点所需的技能。 需要注意的是，这里的奇点更多说的是「递归自我改进」： 奇点＝智能体能够递归地自我改进其生命周期的每一个阶段。 在论文中，Opus 5.5 + Claude Code，自主构建了预训练流水线、推理引擎，以及集群编排器等 AI Infra。 在同一批 GPU 上，这套由 AI 「手搓」出来的系统，性能不仅追平，甚至直接碾压了人类工程师引以为傲的 SGLang 和 NVIDIA Dynamo 等生产级工具。 研究人员直言： 在由7个前沿模型和2个运行框架构建的11个智能体中，Opus 5.5配合Claude Code在全部六项任务上达到或超过人类基线，奇点指数为1.25，这表明它可能已具备通往奇点所需的技能。 砸场子的 Singularity-Bench，与被碾压的人类傲慢 过去几年， AI 跑分榜单无数，但毫无疑问Singularity-Bench（奇点基准测试）这个名字让人一听就「眼前一亮」。

members.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
members.content: View PDF Abstract:Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy?

members.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
members.content: Published on Nov 12 · Submitted by lxy on Nov 16 Authors: , , , , , , Abstract Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch.

members.title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices.

members.title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix?

members.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Demonstrations are an effective way to accelerate single-agent reinforcement learning (RL), but extending this idea to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is non-trivial as it is difficult and often impossible for a single person to teleoperate multiple agents simultaneously. Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC) addresses this by letting a single demonstrator control one agent at a time while the others execute their current policies. However, the resulting imitation policies are limited by the quality of the demonstrations.

members.title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
members.content: View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract:Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies.
